comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (32.53%) to Oh-defensin C: 10%. GRAVY: 0.156; mol Wt: 8651.103; mol formula: C379H595N93O114S10; mol ex coeff: 4970. Activity: inhibited the growth of Gram- P. aeruginosa PAO1, the Gram-positive species B. thuringiensis, B. megaterium QM B1551 and B. cereus ATCC 14579 compared to the control. Bacteriocidal. Recombinant production:bacteria:Escherichia coli: expressed in the BL21 (DE3) construct containing an N-terminal 6xHis tag, and SUMO solubility tag as in soulble inclusion bodies. Structure: predicted by alphafold 2 to have a combined alpha and beta structures. updated 4/2025 GW
title: A novel family of defensin-like peptides from Hermetia illucens with antibacterial properties.
